item.title: Lamar CISD police officers placed on leave, under investigation, school district confirms
item.description: An investigation is underway involving Lamar CISD's police department. The district confirmed two officers have been placed on administrative leave, but details remain limited.

item.title: Part of I-10 in east Houston may remain closed until Monday due to sinkhole, TxDOT says
item.description: TxDOT advised Houston drivers that the eastbound lanes on East Freeway near Federal Road could be closed until Feb. 9 due to repairs on a sinkhole.

item.title: HAR will not display flood risk data on listings after pushback from members
item.description: The Houston Association of Realtors is making headlines over its decision to not include flood risk information directly on home listings after pushback from its members.

item.title: Fort Bend ISD estimates it could lose $7.8M due to the new voucher program
item.description: With parents now able to apply for Texas' new school voucher program, one district released estimates on how it could impact its budget.

item.title: 'The Muppet Show' returns for new adventures, featuring Sabrina Carpenter
item.description: If you watched "The Muppets" in decades past, you'd see such stars as Rita Moreno, Elton John and Liza Minnelli. Now, 50 year later, it's time to play the music and it's time to light the lights again!

item.title: Olivia Colman and John Lithgow star 'Jimpa,' new queer family drama
item.description: Three generations, one city and a whole lot of heart. Stars Olivia Colman and John Lithgow tell "important message" behind their new film, "Jimpa."

item.title: 13-year-old girl killed in stabbing in northwest Houston, 10-year-old boy detained, HPD says
item.description: A 13-year-old girl is dead after she was stabbed in northwest Houston, HPD said. They added that a 10-year-old boy was detained.

item.title: 2 tornadoes touched down in Plum Grove area of Liberty County during severe weather, NWS confirms
item.description: SkyEye images showed debris scattered around a property in the Plum Grove area. The National Weather Service confirmed two tornadoes touched down in Liberty County.

item.title: Child abduction suspect in Galveston incident violated probation and bail conditions: Prosecutors
item.description: At the time of his arrest on a kidnapping charge in Galveston, Graham Dunn was already a wanted man, according to records obtained by Eyewitness News.

item.title: Former Texas Department of Family and Protective Services employee accused of child trafficking
item.description: Hannah Nicole Sample was a Texas Department of Family and Protective Services employee until July 2023, according to the agency.
